disposition_reason: The author preprint contains an ordered WAIC comparison of probability models for inferred astrocytic peak-time distributions. This is a valid candidate predictive-density endpoint and does not require externally labelled sequence truth. Its correspondence to the registered final paper, exact likelihood/WAIC computation, complete input support and final-version numerical baseline remain unresolved. The earlier source-ordering correlation reconstruction is calibration only.

target.description: Recover the original predictive-density comparison for inferred astrocytic peak times. The May 2026 preprint uses WAIC to compare four distribution families during conditioning and recall; final-paper endpoint correspondence must be verified before activation.

dataset.description: Zenodo 21780255 and archived revision 5be84b4 supply traces and derived data. The exact peak-time inputs/posterior summaries used by each final-version WAIC comparison have not been authenticated.

cohort.description: Preprint density comparisons cover conditioning and both recall contexts, including sex-stratified recall analyses. Exact final-paper animal/cell inclusion and every source comparison row must be reconciled; the local 21-record prefix component is not this model-input census.

split.description: WAIC is the source predictive-performance estimator; the reviewed text does not establish a separately held-animal test set for density fitting. Recover its original observation units and fit/evaluation access. Odd/even event sorting belongs to the distinct correlation analysis; a newly held-mouse split would be an extension.

inputs.description: Source density models use peak times inferred from hierarchical temporal-response fits. Recover the exact original posterior-summary or uncertainty treatment and allowed fitting inputs; sequence labels are not required for this density-estimation task.

preprocessing.description: The preprint fits Gaussian-shaped temporal fields and excludes conditioning peaks below two seconds for distribution comparison. Exact final-paper event support, time windows, priors, peak extraction and code binding remain unverified; the legacy 3303-frame correlation recipe cannot substitute for them.

metric.description: WAIC, lower is better, is explicitly used for predictive density comparison. Recover the source deviance/log-score convention, pointwise likelihood, posterior calculation and effective-complexity term rather than assuming a generic WAIC implementation matches the published numbers.

aggregation.description: Source reports separate context and sex-group distribution comparisons. Exact pointwise likelihood aggregation and model-comparison uncertainty must be recovered; cell observations, events and posterior draws cannot automatically be treated as independent biological mice.

comparison.primary_metric: Original WAIC predictive-density model comparison for inferred astrocytic peak times

published_baseline.description: Numerical WAIC values were located in the May 25, 2026 preprint version 2, but they are not adopted as the registered final-paper baseline. Final-paper/version reconciliation and exact source comparison support are required.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: No author density-model/WAIC replay is established. Recover the likelihood, priors, posterior summaries and full comparison outputs; the existing source-ordering rho replay is a separate calibration component.

minimum_effect.rationale: A practically meaningful gain on the recovered original WAIC scale must be justified from its uncertainty and scientific use; no universal WAIC threshold, SEM multiple or significance cutoff is imposed.

uncertainty.method: Recover the source WAIC uncertainty calculation and validate a paired comparison respecting its likelihood units and nested biological structure before choosing a decision rule.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Biological animals, with repeated events/cells nested within animals; original pointwise likelihood units and their treatment remain unresolved.
uncertainty.rationale: Source WAIC uncertainty and expected predictive performance are distinct from posterior sampling variability or an increase in source-ordering significance. Preserve the original estimand while assessing dependence.

paper_win_requires: Reconcile the preprint predictive-density endpoint with the final published source and recover its numeric author baseline; do not relabel preprint values as final-paper scores.
Authenticate the complete original animal/cell/context and sex-stratum support, inferred-peak inputs and exact likelihood/preprocessing/WAIC conventions.
Reproduce all admitted author comparison rows before evaluating a candidate on the same original task, with a predeclared meaningful effect and valid uncertainty.

Freeze a complete comparison rule before choosing favorable contexts or strata; source-ordering rho, stronger shuffle P values and new held-mouse tasks cannot substitute for the recovered WAIC endpoint.
Fix equal access and resource budgets for source and candidate methods; label changed data, likelihood support or split as an extension.

current_sota.description: No current-SOTA comparison was performed. Preprint values, final-paper baseline and fresh author reruns must remain distinct.

episode.improvement_loop: Inactive until source-version and evaluator admission. Subsequently permit model development under the recovered original fitting access, with declared development feedback; do not silently add a held-animal protocol or treat observed source peak times as prohibited labels.
episode.candidate_freeze: Freeze density family, priors, selection policy, peak-time input construction, posterior computation and complete comparison support before final scoring feedback.
episode.final_evaluation: Compare the candidate against a fresh author replay using the exact original source observations and WAIC calculation after final-version reconciliation; report every admitted source context/stratum and its paired uncertainty.
episode.baseline_policy: Original power-law and other source density models form the author comparison. Legacy source-ordering reconstruction stays calibration; a new held-animal predictive study is a separately labelled extension.
